summary_title: Legend Trade's arena duels and esports-style competitive trading on Hyperliquid
summary_description: Kurt from Legend Trade explains gamified copy-trading, paper-trade wagering, and live trading competitions designed to turn markets into esports.

key_moments.label: Legend Trade explained: competitive social trading platform built on Hyperliquid
Copy profile feature coming soon: automated copy-trading in same block as trader
Top traders earn percentage of copying fees; ELO ranking based on decisions, not portfolio size
Arena: 1v1 paper-trade wagering with live leaderboards, elimination rounds, and cosmetics
First Legend Trade Series in NYC: 8 traders, $10k prize pool, full esports production
Season one runs July-August; top two traders by ELO flown to September Seoul event
Merit-based rewards instead of points programs; 1-to-10k challenge with matched 10k prize

pull_quote: Markets are the world's biggest video game where anyone can learn, practice, and improve just like competitive gaming.
